mapper.select: select br.id, br.book_id, br.user_id, br.borrow_time, br.due_date, br.renew_count, br.status, br.create_time, br.update_time, b.book_name, b.isbn, u.user_name, u.nick_name from borrow_record br left join book b on br.book_id = b.id left join sys_user u on br.user_id = u.user_id where br.user_id = #{userId} and br.book_id = #{bookId} and br.status = '0' limit 1
where br.status = '0' and br.due_date <= #{dueDate} and br.due_date >= now() order by br.due_date asc
where br.status = '0' and br.due_date < now() order by br.due_date asc
where br.user_id = #{userId} and br.status = '0' and br.due_date < now() order by br.due_date asc
select count(1) from borrow_record where date(borrow_time) = date(#{today})
select count(1) from borrow_record where status = '1' and date(return_time) = date(#{today})
select count(1) from borrow_record where status = '0' and due_date < now()

select date_format(borrow_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(1) as count from borrow_record where borrow_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(borrow_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select dd.dict_label as categoryName, count(br.id) as borrowCount from borrow_record br left join book b on br.book_id = b.id left join sys_dict_data dd on b.category_id = dd.dict_value and dd.dict_type = 'book_category' where 1=1
and br.borrow_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
group by dd.dict_value, dd.dict_label order by borrowCount desc
where date(br.borrow_time) = date(#{today}) order by br.borrow_time desc
